## About
Yellow Engine Services works out of our headquarters on Martin Street in Fort Worth. We craft re-manufactured Caterpillar, Cummins, Detroit, John Deere and Isuzu engines, and custom engines may be available upon request.
We deliver exchange heavy duty Diesel engines for trucks, off-road automotive, marine and all industrial applications for Diesel & Natural Gas Engines. Exchange components are on hand too: heads, blocks, crankshafts, rods, cams, fuel pumps, injectors, oil pumps and water pumps.
Need a spec rather than a part? We answer technical questions on torque of bolts, settings and parts that interchange.

## Services
- Exchange Engines: Caterpillar, Cummins, Detroit, John Deere, Isuzu and other makes. Custom engines may be available upon request.
- Exchange Components: Heads, blocks, crankshafts, rods, cams, fuel pumps, injectors, oil pumps and water pumps.
- Fuel injection and turbo re-manufacturing: Fuel injection and turbo components re-manufactured in house.
- Starter and alternator re-manufacturing: Starters and alternators re-manufactured, with a parts contact dedicated to them.
- Engine repower and power unit fabrication: Engine repower or complete power unit fabrication design testing.
- Used parts finder and locator service: We track down new and used engine parts or components for any engine.

## FAQ
Q: What warranty comes with a complete engine?
A: Complete engines come with a 6-month unlimited-hour warranty. Some seasonal equipment, such as farm and aquatic engines, has a 1-year warranty.

Q: What about long block and short block purchases?
A: Long block purchases come with a 90-day warranty. Short block purchases come with a 30-day warranty.

Q: What if I need an engine make you don't list?
A: Other makes and custom engines may be available upon request. Send a quote request and tell us what you're running.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 7:30 AM – 4:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.
